# Readiness Requirements Checklist: Discuss a Freehand Sketch

**Purpose**: Review requirement clarity, coverage, and cross-artifact consistency before task generation
**Created**: 2026-11-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Focus**: Voice/MCP feasibility boundaries, sketch-sharing privacy, and desktop/iPhone interaction
**Depth**: Standard, with additional attention to the external capability and session lifecycle risks
**Audience / Timing**: Project author or peer reviewer, after planning and before task generation

**Note**: Generated by `$speckit-checklist` from the current feature and accepted scope decisions.
**Review Ownership**: This is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact. Mark an item `[x]`
only after the reviewer determines the criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the written requirement passes review; it does not mean the
product is implemented or that runtime acceptance has passed. New items remain unchecked.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the freehand drawing, selection, discussion, and manual revision boundaries defined as one useful user journey? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1; Spec §FR-001–FR-005]
- [x] CHK002 Are desktop pointer input, iPhone finger input, and the permitted two-device arrangement explicitly scoped? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions; Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK003 Are pairing, ending a session, and the absence of app accounts distinguished clearly enough to define who may access a sketch? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014–FR-016]
- [x] CHK004 Are the session-only data warning and the distinction between app retention and ChatGPT retention specified before sharing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015–FR-016]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the meaning of selected visual content precise about boundary-crossing strokes, empty regions, and excluded interface content? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003–FR-008; data-model.md §Selection region]
- [x] CHK006 Is the point at which a snapshot becomes immutable defined for drawing and selection changes occurring during a read? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006; data-model.md §Capture request]
- [x] CHK007 Is the meaning of latest successful read consistent with the more limited claim that an image was sent, rather than understood by AI? [Clarity, Conflict, Spec §FR-011; contracts/local-session.md §Presence and cancellation]
- [x] CHK008 Are read failure, cancellation, timeout, and retry distinguished with an unambiguous freshness rule? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008–FR-010; contracts/mcp.md §Errors]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Do the spec, plan, and feasibility guide consistently distinguish completed design work from unproven voice-and-image acceptance? [Consistency, Spec §SC-007; Plan §Constitution Check; feasibility.md §Decision rules]
- [x] CHK010 Are local-only hosting and deferred cloud deployment consistent across the constitution, spec, and planning inputs? [Consistency, Constitution §Product Scope and Constraints; Spec §Assumptions; planning-inputs.md §Later scope decisions]
- [x] CHK011 Are immediate explicit session end and best-effort detection of browser closure distinguished without contradictory revocation promises? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016; data-model.md §Sketch session; contracts/local-session.md §Presence and cancellation]
- [x] CHK012 Are read-only AI access and the exclusion of embedded voice, in-app chat, semantic recognition, and structured diagrams consistent across artifacts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012–FR-013; Spec §Assumptions; Plan §Summary]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Is the evidence needed to satisfy the voice-and-image gate explicit, including a fresh second read and an actual spoken answer? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007; feasibility.md §Procedure]
- [x] CHK014 Are the permissions granted by controlled-image success versus live selected-sketch success clearly separated? [Clarity, Spec §SC-007; feasibility.md §Decision rules; Plan §Execution Boundaries]
- [x] CHK015 Are participant mix, completion threshold, timing boundaries, and device allocation defined for the first-use outcome? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK016 Are comparison-task equivalence and response-quality judgments defined sufficiently to make pilot outcomes repeatable rather than subjective? [Measurability, Gap, Spec §SC-005–SC-006]
- [x] CHK017 Are the performance percentile, drawing size, device baseline, and measurement interval specified sufficiently for an objective acceptance decision? [Measurability, Gap, Spec §SC-004; quickstart.md §Acceptance walkthrough]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK018 Are alternate desktop drawing and iPhone drawing journeys covered without requiring same-iPhone voice use? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1; Spec §Assumptions; quickstart.md §Stage 4: iPhone drawing with desktop voice]
- [x] CHK019 Are requirements defined for missing selection, blank content, ambiguous handwriting, and unavailable AI discussion? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases; Spec §FR-008; Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK020 Are reconnection and explicit re-pairing requirements defined for browser suspension and local service restart while local ink survives? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3; contracts/local-session.md §Presence and cancellation]
- [x] CHK021 Are unsupported voice capability and unavailable account access assigned explicit stop or scope-revision outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §SC-007; feasibility.md §Decision rules]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK022 Are requirements explicit about reads during unfinished gestures and selection changes so partial or mixed snapshots have a defined outcome? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006; data-model.md §Capture request]
- [x] CHK023 Are simultaneous reads, late results, duplicate results, and cancelled requests covered without permitting stale-image substitution? [Coverage, contracts/mcp.md §Errors; contracts/local-session.md §Presence and cancellation]
- [x] CHK024 Are pairing changes during an outstanding read and the non-retractability of already shared bytes addressed consistently? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016; contracts/mcp.md §Success; contracts/local-session.md §Presence and cancellation]
- [x] CHK025 Are oversized drawings, image limits, exhausted session capacity, and applicable user-facing recovery requirements explicit rather than silent data truncation? [Coverage, Gap, data-model.md §Stroke and drawing state; contracts/local-session.md §Browser operations]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK026 Are session isolation, credential separation, and the trusted-private-network boundary documented despite the no-login scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014; Spec §Assumptions; contracts/local-session.md §Topology]
- [x] CHK027 Are transient-image requirements extended to logs, caches, diagnostics, and review artifacts with clear retention boundaries? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016; data-model.md §Sketch snapshot; contracts/local-session.md §Browser operations]
- [x] CHK028 Are accessible control names, focus, phone target sizes, status announcements, and intentional accessibility exclusions documented? [Completeness, contracts/local-session.md §UI contract]
- [x] CHK029 Are connection deadlines and loss-of-presence bounds quantified and explained as product constraints rather than implied instant closure detection? [Clarity, data-model.md §Sketch session; contracts/local-session.md §Presence and cancellation]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK030 Are desktop-client availability, account/workspace conditions, and local connection assumptions sourced separately from runtime acceptance evidence? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions; research.md §1–2; feasibility.md §Prerequisites]
- [x] CHK031 Are requirements for the local desktop host and private-network phone access specified without treating hosted web chat as equivalent? [Clarity, Plan §Connection Decision; quickstart.md §Stage 3–4]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK032 Are stale checklist notes about independent questions, a single pending chat attempt, and earlier requirement numbering identified for reconciliation with the freehand external-conversation scope? [Conflict, checklists/requirements.md §Notes; Spec §Functional Requirements]
- [x] CHK033 Are the constitution’s test-first obligations and its voice-feasibility gate traceable to planning decisions without treating an unchecked runtime outcome as completed? [Traceability, Constitution §V; Constitution §Product Scope and Constraints; Plan §Execution Boundaries]
